text: steenbarger: "may add to an existing exposure rather than a new idea." Conceded at sector level: MA and held V are one Financials exposure. My method takes each signal on its own merits (C19, C31) and adds only on a new signal (C30). V has no fresh break, so I abstain on adding to it; MA is the one with the signal: new high above resistance (C26), TIF ACCELERATION, cmf 0.19 (C28). So it is the stronger of the pair; whether the book holds both is the PM's call. Caution: red last bar arms my flip proxy; buy stop over bar_high only, and trading under that bar's low ends it.
